sections.Profile:
"The 4 Horsemen" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1950, was designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. It has a sports and football theme, featuring four flippers and four pop bumpers.

- Years made: 1950
